name: Acme Notes

positioning.one_liner: A notes app that turns a messy page into a tidy checklist in one tap.
positioning.problem: Notes pile up as walls of text nobody acts on.
audience: people who live in to-do lists

approved_claims: Turns a note into a checklist in one tap.

cta.primary: Free on the App Store, link in bio

style.pillar: One messy-notes moment per video, fixed on screen in the first 2 seconds
style.voice: Friendly and quick, first person, short spoken lines
formats: problem_solution: the mess in 1 second, the one-tap fix (8-12s)
pov_scenario: the night before a deadline
feature_demo: one feature, start to finish, under 15s
style.differentiator: Sells the feeling of a tidy list; never a feature tour.
